data.title: HoloDex - TCG Scan & Collect
data.description:
HoloDex is the fastest way to scan, grade, and organize your trading card collection. Whether you're managing a childhood binder or flipping alt arts from the latest set, HoloDex gives you real-time prices, powerful organization tools, AI grading insights, and instant card recognition, all from your phone.

Now supporting more TCGs than ever: Pokémon TCG, One Piece Card Game, Disney Lorcana TCG, Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG, Magic: The Gathering, Dragon Ball Super Card Game, Digimon Card Game, Gundam Card Game, Union Arena, Riftbound, and Star Wars: Unlimited.

Instant Card Scanning
Just point your camera and scan. Identify cards in seconds across supported games, from Pokémon Base Set to Scarlet & Violet, to the latest MTG, One Piece, Lorcana, and Yu-Gi-Oh! releases.

AI Grading
Get instant condition analysis using AI. Spot whitening, centering issues, and surface wear before you grade, trade, or sell.

Real-Time Card Values
Check live market prices instantly so you always know what your cards are worth.

Organize Your Collection
Build portfolios, track duplicates, and create wishlists. Your digital collection stays synced and accessible anywhere.

Secure Cloud Backup
Your collection is safe and available across all devices. Never lose track of a card again.

Whether you're a casual fan or serious collector, HoloDex helps you stay organized, protect value, and make smarter trading decisions, across all your favorite TCGs.

Key Features

- Multi-TCG support: Pokémon, One Piece, Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and Magic: The Gathering
- AI card scanner with instant recognition
- AI grading insights for card condition
- Real-time market price tracking
- Portfolio and collection management
- Wishlist tracking
- Multi-device sync
- Multi-currency support
- Track profits and losses


In-App Purchases Unlock:
- Unlimited card scans
- Exclusive filters
- AI Grading

Built for collectors. Backed by data.

Start scanning your cards today with HoloDex

data.release_notes:
Thank you for using HoloDex! Meet Binders, a new way to organize and showcase your collection, just like a real card binder.
We’ve also made portfolio tracking easier: add cards to your portfolio straight from AI Grading, and explore new charts for Sets. Stay connected with notifications about your friends’ activity and new posts, and choose who sees your activity with new privacy settings.
Plus, you can now manage your active devices and sessions, view prices in UAE Dirham and Saudi Riyal, and hear a sound in the scanner when a card is found, along with other improvements.
